_how: Copy to calibration/brand_map.json. Keys = Shelf brand names exactly as in brands.txt; values = OFF barcodes in data/products/catalog.json that the sim stocked for that brand. If brand_map.json is absent, compare.py matches catalog.json `brand` case-insensitively. Unmapped Shelf brands are dropped from the comparison (and listed in compare.json inputs.brands_compared).
_source: assumption: manual mapping by the team on the day; each code must exist in catalog.json (OFF product page https://world.openfoodfacts.org/product/<code>)
